ui.chat.directory.announce.invalid.role: live-region announcement after a directory commit
ui.chat.directory.announce.invalid.tone: statement, sentence case, trailing period where shown
ui.chat.directory.announce.invalid.note: Polite screen-reader announcement, never a toast. The invalid arm must not claim the commit failed for permission reasons: the check is readability.

placeholders.path: a directory path as the machine spells it. Keep it verbatim, including `~` and separators; never translate a path.
